title: SCHC create_sender must validate key_generation like control mint
description: P3 (wave-2 review of worker6-edbw): python/src/lichen/schc/session_manager.py create_sender (~:450) accepts key_generation=None without validation, while _issue_control_wire_unlocked now rejects None at mint. A session created with None generation turns terminal transitions into a raise-loop: at MAX_ACK_REQUESTS exhaustion or timeout the mint raises FragmentError after the ACK receipt was consumed (record.pending.pop at :798) and high_water advanced (:824/:838), leaving the record active and unabortable until idle expiry. Also leaves the fragment branch of consume_fragment_wire (:354) with the same structural None-is-None vacuity already tracked in project-LICHEN-worker6-sppu. Not reachable via production schc_handler.py (dict-indexed generations never None) - defense in depth. Fix: validate generation on session creation (reject None, exact type) and add a None-generation session test.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-sppu (same finding, filed by the edbw implementation agent during wave 2).
